notes: Assumes a transfer lasts 16*PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV i_clk cycles from the command handshake edge A. flow_pause is set at edge A+16D, so it is sampled from the following edge and covers the cycles starting at A+16D, through the cycle ending at the next handshake edge P. A handshake at A+16D starts a new transfer and does not enter Pause. o_mosi and o_sclk must be stable across consecutive Pause cycles. The first Pause cycle is not compared with the previous one, because that cycle was still part of the transfer. The check is vacuous if the DUT never pauses, which is visible in the hit count.
